value.body: A heritage tour guide takes visitors around forts, temples, old city quarters and museums, explaining their history in an engaging way. Work comes from tour operators, travel agencies, hotels, heritage-walk groups and direct bookings, often on a freelance basis. A day may involve several walks, a lot of standing and walking, and adapting the story to each group.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.A. History, plus a guide training or certification course

items.label: Licensing
items.value: Many protected monuments and tourist circuits require a guide licence or approved certification
items.note: Issued by the Ministry of Tourism or the state tourism department; rules vary by site and state

items.label: Useful extras
items.value: A second language such as French, German, Spanish or Japanese

items.label: Centrally protected monuments (ASI)
items.note: Monuments and sites of national importance under the Archaeological Survey of India
items.source: Rajya Sabha reply via PIB, as reported

items.label: UG students in Hospitality and Tourism
items.note: All years. Counts only institutions that responded to AISHE, so national totals may be higher.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: After a B.A. History, most guides complete a Ministry of Tourism or state tourism guide training and certification, then start by assisting senior guides or working with tour operators and heritage-walk groups. A foreign language widens the client base.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Historical knowledge of a region or circuit

value.title: At a glance
items: Income is often seasonal and depends on tourist flows.
Many guides are freelance; building a reputation and referrals takes time.
Next steps: tour manager, heritage-walk organiser, or running your own tours.

competition.note: BA (all subjects) graduates in 2023-24 at institutions that reported to AISHE — everyone finishing that degree, not only those entering this role.
competition.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 34 (programme-wise out-turn), Ministry of Education
